payload_entities.source_actor: Original native owner/caster identity and native persistence; see payload records for ownerless/source alternatives.
payload_entities.native_lifecycle: Projectile constructor normalizes direction*.1; tick native owner/loaded-chunk admission runs Projectile.tick, movement ray (COLLIDER), native impact hook and hitTargetOrDeflectSelf, inside-block check; save v then position+=v, rotate.2F, next velocity=(v+normalize(v)*accelerationPower)*inertia (air1/water.8F). Server removed owner or unloaded current chunk discards; client bypasses that check. No lifetime timer. Inherited owner persists; own NBT saves acceleration_power only, not DAMAGE, so native reload damage resets synced0. Unpickable and hurt alwaysfalse. Native deflection super then player sets acceleration.1, otherwise halves it.

payload_entities.source_actor: Original native owner/caster identity and native persistence; see payload records for ownerless/source alternatives.
payload_entities.native_lifecycle: Uses native Projectile trace/impact admission and old-velocity movement; acceleration/inertia air.6F/water.8F. Fuse decrements on both sides after movement, even after a discard statement. Server lazily resolves loaded target UUID once; failed lookup clears targetId. Alive finalTarget and non-spectator Player target: when distance>.1, strength=clamp((distance-1)/10,.1,1), blend normalized current velocity/target direction, normalize, then assignDirectionalMovement(newDirection,getInertia()). That helper normalizes again and fixes speed to air inertia.6F even in water. Invalid/dead/spectator target creates radius1 NONE explosion+discard, then independent fuse<=0 branch can create another radius1 explosion+discard. Native onHitEntity/onHitBlock may already have exploded earlier the same tick. No added callback suppression.

payload_entities.native_lifecycle: Native smoke constructor duration600/wait20, overridden by howitzer to300/5; radius clamp0..32 and dimensions(width2radius,height.5). Server age>=wait+duration discards and returns. Before wait only updates waiting flag then returns. Each active tick adds radiusPerTick; if result<.5 discards and returns, otherwise clamps/stores radius. Every5 ticks attempts payload. radiusOnUse and durationOnUse are stored/save/load but never consumed in tick/damage. Native getOwner lazily resolves UUID on ServerLevel; setOwner stores object+UUID. read NBT accepts Owner UUID, but addAdditionalSaveData DOES NOT WRITE Owner, so freshly saved/reloaded smoke loses caster and uses anonymous wither behavior. Saves Age,Duration,WaitTime,DurationOnUse,RadiusOnUse,RadiusPerTick,Radius.

payload_entities.native_lifecycle: Native laser constructors normalize direction*.1, set native owner and synced damage. tick uses native owner/chunk admission, parent Projectile.tick, COLLIDER move trace, impact hook/deflection, inside blocks; position+=oldV then velocity=(oldV+normalize(oldV)*accelerationPower)*1. No water override or age limit. Own NBT only acceleration_power, with native parent owner; reload DAMAGE0. Unpickable and hurtfalse. onDeflection parent first, player acceleration=.1 else *=.5. No extra per-victim cache.

payload_entities.native_lifecycle: Stored Harbinger caster drives server yaw/pitch and anchorY+2.7 each tick, after initial spawnY+2.9. Native endpoint30 uses synced angles on server; block COLLIDER/Fluid.NONE trace normalizes only BLOCK result via helper. Candidate LivingEntity query bbox spans origin to block collision/end inflated1, but each victim padded bbox (native pickRadius+.5) is clipped using FULL from/to endpoint, not collision endpoint. Thus do not infer strict wall occlusion beyond this native query/clip combination. No victim-alive/noPhysics admission added here. After warmup20, repeated ray dispatch continues while native on/fade state ages: turn onfalse when tickCount-20>duration, decay appear timer3, discard on later onfalse/timer0 but no return. Caster-dead discard also lacks return. With normal duration60 and continued ticks, attempted dispatch ages21..85 inclusive (65 possible calls per continuously selected victim); native hurt may reject them. NBT read/save are empty, no caster UUID/angles/damage/duration/fire serialization. Client resolves casterID only at age1; server never resolves a loaded caster from ID.
